notes: Randomised block trials at three Malian sites, 2020-2023, six NPK microdosing rates vs no fertilizer and vs recommended row application 100 kg NPK/ha; all plots also got 150 kg urea/ha. Economic results are reported only as means across sites and years (no site x treatment interaction), mostly in Figs 6-7 with printed data labels; text gives a few VCR values and gross-margin increments. Comparator: the vocabulary excludes no-fertilizer controls for nutrient_mgmt_b, so rows use the recommended row application as control; the no-fertilizer values are given in notes. Microdosing at 93.7 kg/ha is close to the 100 kg/ha recommended rate, so not every rate is 'lower nutrient input'; all are per-hill placement. Study design: sites include the Sotuba research station; whether the others are on-farm is not stated, recorded as experiment_on_station (uncertain). Not extracted: yields (Table 3, Figs 3-5), FUE/NUE, urea-rate test (no economics). Labour rows are man-days, not money (no WB outcome for labour quantity; mapped to Labour Cost with unit man-days/ha).
